data.description:
# Epic: Option A — status-neutral assignee CAS claim for the audit tier + remove `needsProducerReview`

Parent/root cause: WL-0MV7W77AY005MGBL (Herdr downtime audit claim leaves item in-progress/in_review; failed audit coerces to in-progress/plan_complete).

## Goal (user story)

As an operator running herdr downtime dispatch, when the audit tier auto-dispatches an audit of a completed/in_review item and the audit then fails (Phase 2 timeout, infra failure, killed pane), I want the item to remain completed/in_review — on the review queue and re-selectable — so failed audits never strand work in in-progress/plan_complete. Also, I want a per-item way to pause automatic scheduling (assign the item to the producer) that is explicit and does not rely on a magic DB flag.

## Approach (Option A)

Replace the audit-tier claim's status flip with a **status-neutral claim**: the claim's CAS becomes the **assignee** instead of `status`. Add `--if-assignee <value>` to `wl update` (atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` CAS, same as `updateIfMatches`), then the audit-tier claim writes:

```
wl update <id> --assignee <agent> --if-status completed --if-stage in_review --if-assignee ""
```

The item **stays completed/in_review the whole time** — no hybrid `in-progress/in_review` is ever created, so the audit runner captures completed/in_review as its pre-audit state and its failure-restore path restores completed/in_review correctly (no `_STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT` coercion to plan_complete). Exactly one concurrent pane still wins the claim (CAS on the guarded fields), preserving the WL-0MSRBFFLN005W3VT RC-1 guarantee.

**Remove `needsProducerReview` from the database** and replace its scheduling-hold role with the assignee-based hold (assign to the producer ⇒ no tier claims it ⇒ no auto-dispatch). `needsProducerReview` was added by migration 20260210-add-needsProducerReview and today (a) blocks auto-dispatch in every herdr select* function and (b) gates release in the ship skill (check-final-validation.js). Both roles must be re-homed onto the assignee field.

## Perceived problems and how each is addressed

### P1 — Audit success path never clears assignee (residue accumulates)
`audit_runner.py` 'yes' verdict sets completed/in_review + needs-producer-review but no `--assignee ""`. Live DB already shows 698 items with assignee=Map (completed/done) and 7 in_review items carrying an assignee. Under `--if-assignee ""` those become permanently unclaimable.
**Address:** audit runner must clear assignee on every terminal verdict path (success 'yes', failure restore, verdict 'no') — a single `--assignee ""` added to the success cmd (status_lifecycle already clears on failure). Plus a one-time cleanup of legacy residue (698+ items) so the queue does not ossify.

### P2 — rollbackClaimWorkItem does not clear assignee
A failed dispatch (marker-write-failed / spawn-failed) leaves assignee=Map with the `--if-assignee ""` guard failing forever.
**Address:** rollback path for the status-neutral claim must clear assignee (`--assignee ""` guarded on `--if-assignee <agent>`), preserving the same race-safe CAS shape (only this claim's state is reverted).

### P3 — Sync regression guard fights assignee clearing
`assignee` is a merge-participating field; `'Map' → ''` is classified a regression and refused on other roots without `--accept-regressions`, so cleared claims resurrect cross-instance (incl. cross-root coordination offers, WL-0MTQ14W7L003II5A).
**Address:** decide and implement one of: (a) treat assignee as a normal (non-regression-guarded) merge field so '' clears propagate, or (b) accept that assignee is an owned reconciliation field and document the cross-root rule. Must verify the coordination-offer claim path (leader claims offers in the offering instance's root).

### P4 — Every non-empty assignee becomes a dispatch blocker
intake `--assignee`, implement claims, triage "set assignee", delegate `@github-copilot` (delegate-helper.ts writes assignee=@github-copilot + status in-progress) would all suppress future auto-dispatch unless every session end clears the field.
**Address:** (a) define the convention: non-empty assignee = item intentionally held from auto-dispatch (this is the feature), and (b) ensure all skills clear assignee on session end — implement/review changes in status_lifecycle's failure-exit path (already clears), intake, delegate, triage. Document in AGENTS.md.

### P5 — `needsProducerReview` flag removal (DB column + full surface)
Remove the `needsProducerReview` column from workitems and all its consumers:
- migration: drop column (new migration `7026XXXX-drop-needsProducerReview`; keep the add migration for history)
- persistent-store schema/CRUD + jsonl serialization + sync fields
- CLI: `wl reviewed` command (deleted or repurposed), `wl update --needs-producer-review`, `wl list/search/next --needs-producer-review` filters, api.ts query param, cli-types
- herdr: grouping, worklist icon (`needsProducerReviewIcon` / Reviewed meta), pane-lifecycle, pane-close*, stalled-work, settings, fetcher, downtime-worker select* + classifyItemForDispatch (the filtering moves to assignee-based)
- theme.ts producer-review icons
- audit runner setting `--needs-producer-review yes` on top-level yes verdict — replaced by `--assignee <producer>`? (decision needed: what does the producer-hold assignee value look like? e.g. the operator's own identity)
- ship skill check-final-validation.js producer-review gate — re-home onto assignee-capable signal
- interview.ts flag explain/clear flow — replaced or updated

### P6 — GitHub/delegate assignee writes
github.js `--add-assignee`, delegate-helper writes assignee=@github-copilot. These writes a non-empty assignee and would hold items.
**Address:** confirm intent — a GitHub-copilot-assigned item probably SHOULD be held from local auto-dispatch (it is delegated). Verify sync import (github-sync sets assignee:'' on import) does not fight the hold.

### P7 — Release gate semantics
Remove of needsProducerReview must not silently weaken the ship release gate. The producer-review gate in check-final-validation.js uses the flag to block release until a human reviews packaged items.
**Address:** re-home onto the assignee hold: an item assigned to the producer means "the producer owns it" — the release gate checks that such items have been reviewed (audit verdict 'Ready to close: Yes') before closeWorkItemsAfterRelease proceeds.

### P8 — Cross-cutting conventions
- AGENTS.md claim pattern documents the new status-neutral audit claim and the assignee-clearing rule.
- herdr README downtime-dispatcher docs, docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md, CLI.md, docs/icons-design.md, CHANGELOG updated.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `wl update` supports `--if-assignee` CAS (atomic, single-winner; unit + integration tests).
- [ ] Audit-tier claim is status-neutral: item stays completed/in_review through dispatch and failed-audit restore (`wl show` after simulated failure shows completed/in_review).
- [ ] Regression test: herdr dispatch claim → simulated audit Phase-2 failure → item back at completed/in_review, re-selectable (no in-progress/plan_complete, no needsProducerReview-column dependency).
- [ ] Failed dispatch (marker-write-failed / spawn-failed) clears assignee and leaves item re-selectable.
- [ ] Success path clears assignee; legacy residue cleared by a one-time migration/script; audit re-runs still dispatch.
- [ ] Assign item to producer ⇒ no tier auto-dispatches it (claims fail stale at every tier) — the scheduling hold works.
- [ ] `needsProducerReview` column removed from DB; `wl reviewed` and all `--needs-producer-review` CLI/API options removed; no references left in src/, packages/, skill/, .pi/skills/.
- [ ] Ship release gate re-homed onto the assignee hold without weakening release safety (check-final-validation.js updated + tested).
- [ ] Sync regression guard behaviour for assignee documented/decided and tested cross-root.
- [ ] Full test suite passes; CLI.md / docs updated; AGENTS.md claim pattern updated.

## Out of scope
- Option B (audit_runner `_STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT` addition) — keep as fallback if Option A is blocked.
- Changing the implement/plan/intake tiers' status flip (they are legitimately in_progress while worked).
data.title: Option A: status-neutral assignee CAS claim for audit tier + remove needsProducerReview (failed audits keep item completed/in_review)
